title: Wei Jingming and Sun Yang knock out Manika Batra and Ankur Bhattacharjee at WTT Star Contender Muscat
seo_title: WTT Star Contender Muscat: Wei and Sun beat Batra, Ankur
description: Teenage qualifiers Wei Jingming and Sun Yang beat Manika Batra and Ankur Bhattacharjee on day one of the WTT Star Contender Muscat main draw in Oman.
standfirst: Two qualifiers ranked outside the top 200 won on the first day of the WTT Star Contender Muscat main draw, as Elena Zaharia and Csaba Andras came from two games down.

body: Two Chinese teenagers who came through qualifying knocked out India's Manika Batra and Ankur Bhattacharjee on the first day of the WTT Star Contender Muscat main draw on Wednesday.

Wei Jingming, 17 and ranked 222nd, beat Batra, the world No 63, 7-11, 11-6, 11-9, 11-3 in the women's last 64. Sun Yang, an 18-year-old defender ranked 228th, came from 2-1 down to beat Bhattacharjee, the world No 75, 11-8, 5-11, 4-11, 12-10, 11-7 in 41 minutes.
## Wei and Sun go through

Batra took the first game, but Wei won the next two by small margins and then dropped only three points in the fourth. Wei had reached the main draw by beating Romania's Adina Diaconu 3-0 in [qualifying](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-qualifying-day-one-fang-bo-yigenler.html) on Monday. She plays the fifth seed, Romania's Bernadette Szőcs, in the last 32 on Thursday at 1.35pm UK time.

Sun's match turned in the fourth game. Bhattacharjee, 19, had won the second and third games for the loss of nine points, but Sun edged a tight fourth 12-10. The Chinese chopper then pulled away in the decider. His reward is a match against the top seed, Slovenia's Darko Jorgic, at 2.10pm.

It was Sun's fourth win in three days. He came through three rounds of qualifying, including a 48-minute win over Croatia's Ivor Ban and a 3-0 win over France's Esteban Dorr, as Eleven reported in its [qualifying day two report](/news/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026-qualifying-day-two-haug-chen-junsong-kang-dongsoo.html). Tang Yiren, another of China's three men's qualifiers, went out. The 17-year-old lost the first two games to Germany's Andre Bertelsmeier, levelled at 2-2 and lost the decider 11-7.
## Comebacks from two games down

Romania's Elena Zaharia played the longest singles match of the day, beating France's Charlotte Lutz 9-11, 9-11, 11-7, 11-9, 11-5 after 42 minutes. Zaharia, ranked 71st, meets the eighth seed, Elizabet Abraamian, next.

Hungary's Csaba Andras also won from two games down, beating Algeria's Mehdi Bouloussa 10-12, 6-11, 12-10, 14-12, 11-7. The Czech veteran Lubomir Jancarik, 39, did the same against Spain's Alvaro Robles, winning 6-11, 3-11, 11-6, 11-9, 11-8, and plays the seventh seed Dimitrij Ovtcharov at 3.20pm on Thursday.
Portugal's Marcos Freitas, 38, recovered from two games down against China's Huang Youzheng, 21, but lost the decider 11-8.
## Kang's run ends

Kang Dongsoo's run from the [WTT Contender Istanbul final](/news/wtt-contender-istanbul-2026-finals-fang-bo-honoka-hashimoto-titles.html) ended against India's Manav Thakkar, who won 11-7, 11-8, 12-14, 11-5 and now plays the second seed, Shunsuke Togami. Norway's Borgar Haug, who won a 21-19 decider to qualify, lost 11-7, 11-7, 9-11, 11-6 to Japan's Ryoichi Yoshiyama.

South Korea's Kwon Hyuk, 18, beat Croatia's Andrej Gacina, 40, 11-8, 11-9, 6-11, 10-12, 11-4. Japan's Ryuusei Kawakami, 17, beat India's Manush Shah, the world No 45, 3-2 and meets his compatriot Hiroto Shinozuka, the sixth seed.

In the women's draw, Spain's Maria Xiao beat Austria's Sofia Polcanova, the world No 50, 11-8, 11-5, 13-11 in 25 minutes. Sweden's Christina Kallberg came from 2-1 down against South Korea's Yoo Yerin and won the decider 11-5. Japan's Sachi Aoki, 19, did the same against China's Zong Geman, the world No 60, winning 11-8, 2-11, 7-11, 11-7, 11-6. India's Sreeja Akula won the deciding game against Luxembourg's Sarah De Nutte 11-2 and plays the second seed, Honoka Hashimoto, next.
## Doubles

Batra had better luck in the women's doubles, where she and Swastika Ghosh beat the seventh seeds Sofia Polcanova and Yangzi Liu 11-13, 11-7, 11-8, 13-11 to reach the quarter-finals. In the men's doubles, France's Joe Seyfried and Vincent Picard beat the eighth seeds Chen Yuanyu and Huang Youzheng 3-1, and Simon Gauzy and Flavien Coton beat the sixth seeds Ibrahim Gunduz and Abdullah Yigenler 3-1. The top mixed seeds, Alvaro Robles and Maria Xiao, beat Ankur Bhattacharjee and Batra 3-1, and Shunsuke Togami and Satsuki Odo reached the quarter-finals without dropping a game.

## Thursday

The seeds start in the last 32 on Thursday, with singles from 7.35am UK time. Odo, the women's top seed, plays Turkey's Ece Harac at 1.35pm and Hashimoto meets Akula at 9.55am. In the men's draw, South Korea's Park Ganghyeon plays his teammate An Jaehyun at 8.10am, Togami faces Thakkar at 1.35pm and Jorgic plays Sun at 2.10pm. Times are approximate; the [event page](/events/wtt-star-contender-muscat-2026.html) has live scores and the full order of play.
